Per-child height velocity curves from a SITAR fit

Source: R/curve-velocity.R
wgh_velocity_panel.Rd

Evaluates every child's fitted velocity on a grid, either in chronological age or in time relative to the child's own APHV (developmental time). By default each child's curve is kept only within the ages that child was observed (plus extend years), so curves are never read far outside the data, a problem in the developmental-time panel of the original code of the pubertal velocity distribution study (Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.04.26362313).

Usage

wgh_velocity_panel(
  fit,
  ids = NULL,
  time = c("age", "aphv"),
  grid = NULL,
  observed_only = TRUE,
  extend = 0.5
)

Arguments

fit

A wgh_sitar object.

ids

Children to include (default all).

time

"age" (chronological) or "aphv" (years since own APHV).

grid

Grid of ages or offsets.

observed_only

Restrict each curve to the child's observed range.

extend

Years allowed beyond the observed range.

Value

A tibble with id, age, time (age or offset), height and velocity, and attribute "aphv".

Examples

# \donttest{
boys <- growdat2_mini[growdat2_mini$sex == "Male", ]
fit <- wgh_fit_sitar(boys, df = 4, age_range = c(6, 18))
pan <- wgh_velocity_panel(fit, time = "aphv", grid = seq(-4, 4, by = 0.1), observed_only = FALSE)
head(pan)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 5
#>   id        age  time height velocity
#>   <chr>   <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1 C000044  7.70  -4     128.     5.67
#> 2 C000044  7.80  -3.9   128.     5.67
#> 3 C000044  7.90  -3.8   129.     5.67
#> 4 C000044  8.00  -3.7   130.     5.67
#> 5 C000044  8.10  -3.6   130.     5.67
#> 6 C000044  8.20  -3.5   131.     5.67
# }
